The larpers in this comment section is beyond embarrassing.

9.8/10 game *so far,* one of the best GTAs I've played in a long time. From the Random encounters, the freedom to explore and do whatever you want, the honor system & other mechanics from RDR finally coming to GTA, all the side activies, and the story. It's an amazing experience and I'm only just a few hours into Chapter 2. With all the systems showcased in the singleplayer, I can't wait to see what they do with the online, and I also can't wait to play this on my pc lolol. Still, all in all I do not regret my purchase and no one will ever make me doubt it. Never doubted it to begin with at that. I knew this game was going to push the limits on the Criminal & Life Sim Sandboxes the series has been known to do each major release, and they've really outdone themselves with this one. Idk how they'd ever top it outside of uploading out consciousness into the game itself lolol. 

It'd be a 10/10 if it weren't for Jason's voice. Sometimes it's fine but other times it's rough...like there's a filter put over his voice.

snippet.textDisplay:
Let me just say this, is the game horrendous? No. Is it tedious? Very much so. RDR 2 works because even tho the game is "slower" , the wild west setting along with the beautifully crafted world lends itself to this type of playstyle. The world *was* the story of RDR 2 and worked hand in hand with the slow paced storyline of the gang.
GTA on the other hand isn't *really* about the story, sure you have standouts like San Andreas and GTA IV but GTA is mainly known for it's wacky sandbox with player freedom only limited by the hardware, that's why GTA VI doesn't "work", they pretty much slapped the RDR 2 formula onto a GTA game and made it into RDR in the future.

snippet.textDisplay:
We all know why we’re getting GTA 6 at 30 FPS at launch: so Rockstar can make sure every YouTuber and gaming influencer showcases the game with the best possible visuals. And of course, the fact that these dumb kids either don’t understand the difference between 30 and 60 FPS in an action game or simply don’t care, as long as they can say “I’ve got it too!" plays right into that strategy.​
Of course, they could already give players a performance mode or let them adjust the graphics settings for higher framerates—but that wouldn’t look so good in videos, would it?…
That’s why Rockstar will wait 4 months for the initial wave to die down, then release a 60 FPS update, hyped up as a major achievement. And that will give sales another boost.

snippet.textDisplay:
I know this is super specific for such a long clip, but shit like this is why you can't trust the "average gamer's opinion/input" on games.
When Asmon accidentally opened the map for the first time, chat was conflicted between people going "Damn that's really small." And people going "Wow looks big"
There's no sense of like consistency amongst the community for even basic shit like being able to determine size of something. I get that's subjective to a slight degree. But people using emphasis like "Wow! It's a whole country" or whatever, versus people complaining it's small. It's like they're not even living in the same world or watching the same thing.

Not that I'm surprised. Idiots have always existed and always been confident in their ignorance and speaking on shit they know fuckall about with utmost confidence.
People leave reviews on games that are simply just "It's shit. It's a garbage game. It was bad." And if you were to prod them, or they had a better vocabulary and were able to communicate more clearly.. many of them would say things like "I actually don't like TRPGs. So I'm not even the target demographic for this sort of game anyway." Or something. Never seen anyone legitimately say that without it basically having to be extracted from them like pulling teeth.
Not to mention people even conflate "It runs like shit" with just general poor quality. Back when i played WoW, people always blamed their FPS on their Internet connection and shit like that. So frustrating. Keep staying predictable as always average gamers.

snippet.textDisplay: at this point when we see the many things that are implemented into this game that are like DEI coding to block protestors from getting hit, this is what keeps GTA V and it's previous games relevant still. I watched 6 minutes into the intro , already told myself this isn't going to beat GTA V, because at that point five had already established a moving plot. And here, you went to prison cause you robbed a store? And youre getting an ankle monitor? Oh no! Michael has already been to jail several times doing the same thing, only BRIEFLY mentioned late in the intro, no big deal. I mean this comment is from the perspective of someone whos only six minutes in. Maybe it gets better. But to see comments like these make it hard to think the game will be great. It will be good, not great. GTA 3, 4+ bogt, and five are GREAT games. If GTA six doesn't beat five, it will serve as a huge, stark precedent that it doesn't matter how much hype, fueled by a long decade of waiting, off the board of a previous flagship game, that a new game could possess to make it actually great. I mean imagine being somebody like me who still plays on an Xbox One from 2013, who has to make a gamble and splurge on a new console plus the game, imagine paying all that money to get 30 FPS. And i dont want to step into the more sexist side of things, i truly still believe some women can make great games.
